source.name: NCES Digest 2024 Table 330.10
source.coverage: Sector-average published tuition/required fees and on-campus room/board, not net prices or individual-school forecasts. Public fees use in-district charges; out-of-state growth is a proxy. Private series is nonprofit four-year.
source.deflator: Academic-year CPI deflator implied by current/constant-dollar columns; median across 12 reported ratios reduces rounding noise.
breaks: Start at 1986 to exclude earlier board-definition break.
Institution population definition changes after 1995–96; retained and disclosed.
Aggregates reflect enrollment/composition changes and later revisions, not a fixed-school panel.

equityCrosscheck.source: Vanguard VCMM public US equity 10-year outlook
equityCrosscheck.rangeMeaning: Two-percentage-point range around median expectations, not prediction-interval endpoints. Used only as an alternative planning anchor.

macro.interpretation: Named assumption cases, not probability-weighted scenarios. Survey quartiles measure forecaster disagreement, not predictive coverage. BOND10 is expected Treasury yield used as a provisional return anchor, not a measured fund-return forecast.

notes: 24 common academic-year transitions, 2000–2023. Each carries 12 consecutive September–August market months. Block starts align to model years, not calendar months.
General inflation is interpolated monthly from the source academic-year deflator; it is not observed monthly CPI in this model.
Other expenses use general inflation. Off-campus/at-home housing uses CPI; on-campus housing uses published room/board growth.
Treasury returns retain the existing reconstructed nominal bond proxy; total-market stocks use S&P 500 expectations as a broad-equity proxy.
Data-calibrated assumptions and retrospective sector checks do not establish calibrated individual-family success probabilities.
